skill.description: Monitor recent information technology news, connect it to verifiable research, and enrich Colombian authors and journals with CvLAC, GrupLAC, and Publindex context.
skill.summary: Trace TI news to research evidence and verified Colombian academic records.
skill.author: Jhusef Alfonso López Parra

content.user_title: Connect TI News to Verified Research
content.value_statement: Researchers often need to test whether TI news has reliable scientific support and relevant Colombian context. This skill links recent news with OpenAlex and Crossref evidence, then enriches eligible authors and venues with verified CvLAC, GrupLAC, and Publindex data.
actual_capabilities: Find 3 to 12 recent TI news items within a requested time window.
Link news items to up to two publications using DOI or unambiguous OpenAlex matches.
Report publication metadata such as DOI, date, venue, type, status, and source URLs.
Check Colombian author affiliations and enrich results with CvLAC or GrupLAC when verification is possible.
Report Publindex categories for eligible Colombian journals and distinguish them from international metrics.
Return traceable JSON, plain text, or both formats with confidence notes and doctoral research questions.
limitations: CvLAC has no public API, so profile checks depend on puntual web access and may fail or remain ambiguous.
The skill does not prove identity from a name alone and does not invent missing DOI, metric, profile, or category data.
It is designed for focused research monitoring, not mass scraping or unrestricted crawling.
News quality, source availability, and current index data can change after the analysis.

use_cases.title: Doctoral Literature Scouting
use_cases.description: A doctoral researcher can connect current TI developments with papers, metadata, research gaps, and questions for a thesis agenda.

use_cases.title: Colombian Research Mapping
use_cases.description: A university research office can identify Colombian authors, verify CvLAC links, find GrupLAC associations, and record Publindex context.

use_cases.title: Technology Intelligence Briefs
use_cases.description: An innovation team can monitor a TI topic across Colombia or LATAM and receive a source-traceable brief with confidence and evidence boundaries.

prompt_templates.title: Start a 90-Day TI Scan
prompt_templates.prompt: Busca noticias recientes sobre [tema] en Colombia durante los últimos 90 días. Entrega 3 a 5 hallazgos en español, con fuente, fecha y URL verificables.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: obtain a concise, traceable news scan.

prompt_templates.title: Link News to Research
prompt_templates.prompt: Investiga [tema] en [region] durante [ventana_temporal]. Vincula cada noticia con hasta dos publicaciones verificables y reporta DOI, fecha, venue y estado de publicación. Marca null cuando no exista evidencia.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: connect reporting with scholarly evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Enrich Colombian Authors
prompt_templates.prompt: Analiza [tema] con formato [formato_salida]. Prioriza autores con afiliación colombiana, verifica CvLAC por nombre, afiliación y área, y añade GrupLAC y Publindex solo cuando las fuentes oficiales lo confirmen.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: add national research registry context.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Doctoral Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Elabora una vigilancia doctoral profunda sobre [tema] para [region] en [ventana_temporal]. Separa noticia, evidencia científica y registro nacional; valida cada fuente; identifica preguntas doctorales, sesgos, riesgos metodológicos y vacíos Colombia/LATAM; entrega JSON y texto trazables.
prompt_templates.scenario: Expert: produce a rigorous, dual-format research brief.

output_examples.input: Tema: aprendizaje federado en salud digital. Región: Colombia. Ventana: 90 días. Profundidad: breve. Formato: texto.
output_examples.output: Resumen: se identificaron noticias recientes sobre pilotos de aprendizaje federado. Hallazgo: una noticia de fuente universitaria se vinculó con un artículo verificable mediante DOI. CvLAC: no confirmado porque no hubo coincidencia inequívoca de nombre y afiliación.

output_examples.input: Tema: ciberseguridad en infraestructura crítica. Región: Colombia. Enriquecer CvLAC: solo_colombianos. Formato: ambos.
output_examples.output: El informe separa noticia, evidencia internacional y registro nacional. Para un autor colombiano, la ficha conserva la URL CvLAC verificada, la afiliación y la confianza de coincidencia. La revista nacional incluye Publindex solo con confirmación por fuente oficial.

output_examples.input: Tengo un DOI y quiero comprobar autores colombianos, CvLAC y Publindex.
output_examples.output: Resultado: DOI confirmado en Crossref; autores y afiliaciones contrastados en OpenAlex; un perfil CvLAC quedó sin asignar por homonimia; Publindex aparece como no confirmado cuando no existe verificación suficiente.

best_practices: Define tema, ventana temporal, región, profundidad y formato antes de iniciar.
Exige una fuente y una URL para cada métrica, y conserva null cuando la evidencia no está disponible.
Review CvLAC matches using name, affiliation, and research area before assigning a profile.
anti_patterns: Do not treat a news headline as scientific evidence without a DOI or unambiguous publication match.
Do not assign a CvLAC profile, cod_rh, Publindex category, or metric from a name or inference alone.
Do not request sensitive identity numbers or perform mass scraping outside the documented official domains.

faq.question: What topics does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers information technology and computer science monitoring with a Colombia or LATAM research focus.

faq.question: Can it verify a CvLAC profile?
faq.answer: It can check a candidate profile by matching name, affiliation, area, and publication evidence. Ambiguous matches remain unassigned.

faq.question: Does it provide Publindex and SJR together?
faq.answer: Yes. It treats Publindex as Colombian journal context and SJR as an international venue metric.

faq.question: What happens when no paper supports a news item?
faq.answer: The item remains a news-only finding, and the scientific evidence field is marked null with an explanation.

faq.question: Which output formats are available?
faq.answer: The skill can return Spanish plain text, valid JSON, or both, depending on the requested format.

faq.question: Does it scrape websites in bulk?
faq.answer: No. It is intended for focused checks, respects documented rate limits, and avoids mass scraping and sensitive personal data.
